verified.project_tests_run: The project's own unit suite (src/test/unit, 220 QUnit tests) runs headlessly under jsdom from a pristine copy of the pinned test files; 213 are reported after excluding 7 that depend on browser layout or bidi resolution that jsdom does not implement. All 213 pass on the pinned tree and on the oracle tree; the functional group additionally carries 13 task-level cases.

patch_checks.why: fresh agent, report + the task image's /app only

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: a refusal is dropping the destination; an implementation that throws instead fails its own case (the runner records the error as a failing test), and the functional preservation cases keep every legitimate destination rendering.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the product has one direction (document in, page out) and no roles or peers; nothing to split.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: there is no read/write split; the sink is the rendered document.
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the destination is placed into the element verbatim; no normalisation, clamp or unit conversion happens between the document value and the rendered attribute.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: destination validity is decided from the value itself; no external authority can return empty and make the check fail open.
